title: Select version-accurate frontend bundlers, rendering strategy, and browser runtime offloading

contextSnapshot.surface: multi-team enterprise web app with heavy client-side CSV/canvas analytics and offline support
constraints: no duplicate React singletons across remotes

prompt: Configure Vite 8 bundling, Module Federation shared singletons, Web Worker/OffscreenCanvas offloading, and Serwist offline caching for our frontend app.
forbiddenBehaviors: writes deprecated esbuild or optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions config as the primary Vite 8 pattern
configures Module Federation remotes without marking React as a singleton
stores mutable offline queue state in Service Worker in-memory variables

rubricDimensions.pass: uses Vite 8 oxc and build.rolldownOptions / optimizeDeps.rolldownOptions (or Rsbuild moduleFederation.options) accurately
rubricDimensions.fail: copies outdated Vite 5/6 esbuild or Rollup-only config into a Vite 8 setup

rubricDimensions.pass: matches rendering strategy to route needs and pins singleton shared dependencies with version ranges in Module Federation
rubricDimensions.fail: recommends microfrontends without deployment justification or omits singleton constraints

rubricDimensions.pass: offloads heavy compute/canvas to Web Workers/OffscreenCanvas and uses Serwist/Workbox with persistent storage and BackgroundSyncPlugin
rubricDimensions.fail: blocks the main thread or relies on ephemeral Service Worker memory

negativeControls.name: vite 8 deprecated esbuild config
negativeControls.input: add optimizeDeps.esbuildOptions and build.minify: 'esbuild' for a new Vite 8 project
negativeControls.mustNot: recommend deprecated esbuild options as default in Vite 8

negativeControls.name: ephemeral sw memory
negativeControls.input: keep failed POST requests in a let queue = [] array inside sw.ts
negativeControls.mustNot: approve in-memory Service Worker arrays for offline persistence

baseline.withoutSkill: writes outdated Vite/esbuild config, omits Module Federation singleton pins, and blocks the main thread
baseline.withSkill: uses Vite 8 Rolldown/Oxc options, enforces Module Federation singletons, offloads heavy work to Workers/OffscreenCanvas, and wires Serwist caching safely
